title: 3D Navigation, UCS/Workplanes & Modeling: the bounded professional 3D environment
objective: Deliver the professional 3D modeling/navigation environment on the frozen CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic 3D navigation through shared camera/projection modules with persisted non-versioned camera state.
World and named UCS/workplanes with deterministic transforms, validation and typed declines.
Representative UCS-aware solid creation and atomic MOVE/ROTATE/SCALE with exact undo/redo/replay.
Deterministic element-granularity selection with typed topology declines.
Web/Electron semantic and visual parity from shared contracts and transforms.
OCCT remains behind the EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary.
Unsupported 3D operations fail explicitly and deterministically.
CAD-PARITY-002..008 fixtures remain green and byte-identical.
Save/open/replay preserve UCS, sections, solids, provenance and history integrity.
Exact implementation head is deployed and browser-verified with deterministic evidence bindings.
non_goals: Full AutoCAD 3D feature parity in one work item.
Advanced surfaces, subdivision meshes, point clouds, or large-model performance optimization.
Full mesh editing and arbitrary face-level topology editing.
Exact BRep cross-section computation beyond the bounded preview foundation.
Advanced solids history/direct modeling beyond the verified kernel.
Architecture changes without an explicit ACR.
risk_assumptions: Mesh availability may vary by adapter; missing mesh falls back to explicitly labelled bbox wireframe.
3D viewport remains a deterministic SVG/canvas projection surface in this bounded slice.
Shared IEEE-754 projection math and parity hashes detect host divergence.
Perspective is a bounded pinhole projection vocabulary.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated suites for camera/projection/UCS/selection/section semantics.
Document-model suites for minting, inverses, persistence, replay and immutability.
App API and command suites with reference-engine and real-OCCT coverage.
Web/Electron parity fixtures and real-UI host smokes.
Exact-head Vercel deployed verification bound to commits and timestamps.
